title: Claude Cowork and Your First Skills: Set Up Once, Then a New Skill a Week

sections.label: 1 - SET UP CLAUDE COWORK
sections.note: Claude on your own computer, working in one folder you choose, with your email, calendar and files connected. You can start using it the same day.

sections.label: 2 - YOUR FIRST SKILLS
sections.note: A skill is a set of saved instructions Claude reuses, so you explain a task once and get the same result every time. We start with four everyday jobs and test each one on a real example.

sections.label: 3 - ADD A SKILL A WEEK, ONGOING
sections.note: You said ongoing, so the list keeps growing. Each week you tell me the task that took your time and it becomes the next skill.
